description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio and two variables: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis represents the Recent Sequence Ratio, ranging from 0 to 100% with a linear scale and tick labels at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100%. The left y-axis represents Perplexity, spanning from 4.2 to 4.7 with a linear scale and tick labels at 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 4.6, and 4.7. The right y-axis represents the GPU Memory Ratio, ranging from 40 to 100% with a linear scale and tick labels at 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100%. The plot contains four lines: Perplexity (orange, solid line with circle markers), Full Cache PPL (red, dashed line), GPU Memory Ratio (blue, solid line with circle markers), and Full Cache GPU Mem. (blue, dashed line). The Perplexity line starts at approximately 4.63 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 10%, decreases to around 4.3 at 30%, and then fluctuates between 4.3 and 4.35 for the remaining x-axis values. The Full Cache PPL line remains constant at approximately 4.4 across the entire x-axis range. The GPU Memory Ratio line begins at around 40% at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 10%, increases steadily to about 50% at 80%, and then sharply rises to 100% at 100%. The Full Cache GPU Mem. line remains constant at 60% across the entire x-axis range.
